name: skeuo-surface
title: Skeuomorphic Surface
description: Raised and recessed surfaces for composing tactile interfaces.

files.content:
@import "./skeuo-base.css";
.sk-surface{ padding: 28px; border: 1px solid var(--sk-edge); border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(145deg,var(--sk-surface-raised),var(--sk-surface)); }
